VM error codes, limits, disassembly, trace, and syscall registration APIs.

# Purpose
This header file defines the public interface and constants for the Firedancer VM base layer. It collects VM error codes, register and stack limits, memory map layout, and compute unit costs used to validate, execute, and account for SBF programs. It also declares helper APIs for error string conversion, instruction and program disassembly, execution trace storage and printing, and syscall registration for a slot or for all syscalls. The file serves as a central reference for VM behavior and for the values that other modules must use when they work with program execution, tracing, and syscall setup.
